sources.entry: Magnet - Window manager that keeps your workspace organized. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id441258766?platform=mac)

summary.name: Magnet
summary.one_liner: Magnet is a macOS window manager that snaps windows into tiled layouts such as halves, quarters, thirds and fullscreen.
use_cases: Arranging windows side by side on a Mac
Splitting the screen into halves or quarters
Organizing windows across multiple external displays
Creating thirds layouts for wide or vertical monitors
summary.what_it_does: Magnet is activated by dragging windows or through the menu bar, and supports customizable keyboard shortcuts. Dragging a window to a screen corner snaps it into a quarter, while side edges create horizontal and vertical halves. Dragging to the top edge maximizes the window, and the bottom edge creates thirds, which can be slid to expand into two thirds. It also supports up to six external displays and can create thirds along the sides of vertical displays.
notable: Drag-to-edge snapping into quarters, halves, thirds and fullscreen
Supports up to six external displays
Customizable keyboard shortcuts and menu bar access
Available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Platform limited to macOS as named on the page
Pricing not stated on the page
